meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症细胞系的基因依赖与药物敏感性数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在研究癌症基因依赖或寻找药物靶点。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer cell line gene dependency and drug sensitivity data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are studying cancer gene dependencies or identifying drug targets.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 可以查询癌症依赖图谱（DepMap），包括 CRISPR 基因依赖分数、药物敏感性和基因效应谱。它能帮助识别特定癌症的脆弱靶点、发现合成致死相互作用，并验证药物靶点。
howto.when: 当你需要了解某个基因在癌细胞系中的必需性，寻找与特定突变相关的合成致死靶点，或预测药物敏感性时触发。

say.text: 查询KRAS在肺癌细胞系中的依赖分数
分析BRCA1突变肿瘤的合成致死靶点
say.note: 找到在BRCA1突变细胞系中更必需的基因

howto.what_en: This skill allows Claude to query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for CRISPR gene dependency scores, drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. It helps identify cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validate oncology drug targets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to know the essentiality of a gene in cancer cell lines, find synthetic lethal partners for a mutation, or predict drug sensitivity.

say_en.text: Query KRAS dependency scores in lung cancer cell lines
say_en.note: Returns CRISPR Chronos scores for KRAS

say_en.text: Analyze synthetic lethal targets for BRCA1-mutant tumors
say_en.note: Finds genes more essential in BRCA1-mutant lines
